fields.name: close
fields.basis: role adjusted close (split and dividend continuous)

fields.name: raw_close
fields.basis: role raw close (unadjusted)

fields.name: volume
fields.basis: role raw share volume

fields.name: mkt_ret
fields.basis: equal-weight mean adjusted close-to-close return (close[d] / close[d-1] - 1) over the previous session's (d-1) as-of members, broadcast to every name present at d; produced upstream

fields.name: si_shares
fields.basis: FINRA consolidated shares short (currentShortPositionQuantity); as-of: latest row with available_at strictly before date(session), NaN when older than 45 calendar days

fields.name: si_dtc
fields.basis: FINRA days to cover (daysToCoverQuantity, floored at 1.00 by FINRA); as si_shares

fields.name: iv_atm_21d
fields.basis: vendor ATM implied volatility, annualized decimal, 21-session constant maturity; producer domain [0.02, 5] else NaN; candidates also apply the v3 guard

fields.name: earn_recent
fields.basis: indicator: 1 on the vendor earnings price-reaction session (earnFlag 0) and the session after (earnFlag 1), 0 otherwise; NaN when the vendor row is absent

fields.name: shares_out
fields.basis: vendor shares outstanding of the last line row dated <= date(session) - 90 calendar days (A8 lag), restated to the session share basis

fields.name: be
fields.basis: book equity at the anchor period_end A: stockholders equity (else equity including minority interest minus minority interest) minus preferred stock, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: at
fields.basis: total assets at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: at_lag4
fields.basis: total assets at the balance date nearest A - 365 d, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: che
fields.basis: cash and short-term investments at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: debt
fields.basis: short-term plus long-term debt at A, each zero-filled (flagged) when absent while assets exist, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: sale_ttm
fields.basis: revenue, trailing twelve months ending at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: gp_ttm
fields.basis: gross profit (else revenue minus cost of revenue), trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: oi_ttm
fields.basis: operating income (EBIT), trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: ni_ttm
fields.basis: net income, trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: ni_q
fields.basis: net income of the fiscal quarter ending at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: ni_q_lag4
fields.basis: net income of the fiscal quarter ending near A - 365 d, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: be_lag1q
fields.basis: book equity at the balance date nearest A - 91 d (opening equity of the quarter), USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: be_lag1q_lag4
fields.basis: book equity at the balance date nearest A - 456 d (opening equity of the quarter one year earlier), USD; added in fix round 1; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: cfo_ttm
fields.basis: net cash from operating activities, trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: capx_ttm
fields.basis: capital expenditure (payments for PP&E, positive), trailing twelve months, USD; NaN when not reported; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: xrd_ttm
fields.basis: research and development expense, trailing twelve months, USD; NaN when not reported; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: dvc_ttm
fields.basis: common dividends paid, trailing twelve months, USD; zero-filled (flagged) when absent; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: prstkc_ttm
fields.basis: purchases of common stock (buybacks), trailing twelve months, USD; zero-filled (flagged) when absent; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: sstk_ttm
fields.basis: proceeds from issuance of common stock, trailing twelve months, USD; zero-filled (flagged) when absent; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: txt_q
fields.basis: income tax expense of the fiscal quarter ending at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: txt_q_lag4
fields.basis: income tax expense of the fiscal quarter ending near A - 365 d, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: shrs_q
fields.basis: weighted-average diluted shares (else basic) of the fiscal quarter ending at A (else the fiscal year ending at A), shares; as reported, split-restated by the reporting filing; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: shrs_q_lag4
fields.basis: the same concept and duration class ending near A - 365 d, as known at the row clock (latest filing reporting that period, so the anchor filing's split-restated comparative); the pair is NaN when abs(log10 ratio) >= 2 (XBRL scale error); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: noa
fields.basis: net operating assets at A: at - che - lt + debt (Hirshleifer, Hou, Teoh and Zhang 2004), USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: sue
fields.basis: standardized unexpected earnings of the quarter ending at A: seasonal random walk on first-reported quarterly net income, (NI_q - NI_q-4) / sd of the previous <= 8 seasonal differences (>= 4 required); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: fscore
fields.basis: Piotroski (2000) F-score 0-9 at A, all nine signals required, producer-computed; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: me_company
fields.basis: company market equity: sum over the issuer's role lines of shares_out x raw_close (NaN if any linked line is NaN), USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: grp_ff12
fields.basis: Fama-French 12-industry code of the latest visible SUB SIC (T21 grp group); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: grp_ff49
fields.basis: Fama-French 49-industry code of the latest visible SUB SIC (T21 grp group); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: sv_ratio126
fields.basis: FINRA consolidated NMS daily short sale volume ratio: sum(ShortVolume) / sum(TotalVolume) of the CNMSshvol files dated on the sessions d-126..d-1 on which the line's PIT ticker appears (the short-interest producer's symbol map); NaN below 63 such sessions or on a zero TotalVolume sum; the file dated d is never used at d (formula id finra-cnms-ratio126-lag1-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/prepare_research_fields.py, fields-v7)

fields.name: ins_opportunistic_net
fields.basis: (P - S shares) of Form 4 open-market trades by insiders classified opportunistic for the trade year Y (Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012: traded in each of Y-1..Y-3 with no calendar month repeated in all three; routine and unclassified owners excluded) with transaction_date in the 126 sessions t-126..t-1 and visible at t, divided by shares_out[t]; directors and officers on original Form 4s, joint filings with a 10% owner dropped (W5a rule 1); NaN outside [-1, 1] (W5a rule 2), without a visible insider row within 365 days (Section 16 presence) or before 2018 (formula id sec-ins-opportunistic-net126-cmp3y-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_sec.py, fields-v8)

fields.name: inst_best_ideas
fields.basis: Cohen-Polk-Silli conviction at the anchor 13F quarter P: sum over filers m holding the security of max(0, w_m - mw), w_m = the security's screened value / m's total screened long value, mw = its share of the total screened mapped 13F value of P (13F-universe market weight); all 13F filers pooled; NaN without a screened mapped row in a fresh quarter (150-day staleness) (formula id 13f-asof45-best-ideas-cps-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_holdings.py, fields-v9)

fields.name: ftd_shares_ratio21
fields.basis: SEC CNS fails-to-deliver quantity summed over the 21 settlement dates ending at S*(t), the latest settlement date up to which every date is visible (no row = 0 fail), / shares_out at the last role session on or before S*(t); NaN when date(t) - S*(t) > 60 days or shares_out is not finite and positive (formula id sec-ftd-sum21-over-shares-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_holdings.py, fields-v9)

fields.name: ea_days_to_expected
fields.basis: signed sessions from t to the expected next earnings announcement E* (0 = expected today, negative = overdue): E* = the earliest pending yoy_364 date of the CIK's visible primary 8-K item 2.02 rows more than 45 days after the latest announcement A, else A + 91 days; NaN without a visible primary 2.02 within 200 days or when overdue by more than 63 sessions (formula id sec-ea-days-to-expected-yoy364-consume45-fb91-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_sec.py, fields-v8)

fields.name: ea_days_since
fields.basis: t minus the reaction_session (atx-db: session_date for pre-market, intraday and closed-day releases, the next session for post-market) of the latest visible primary announcement A (formula id sec-ea-days-since-reaction-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_sec.py, fields-v8)

fields.name: inst_own_share
fields.basis: 13F institutional ownership at the anchor quarter P: agg_asof45 inst_shares of the security / this run's shares_out at the last role session on or before P (both in P's share basis); NaN when that session is before the role, shares_out there is not finite and positive, or the ratio exceeds 2 (declared plausibility, counted) (formula id 13f-asof45-io-share-qe-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_holdings.py, fields-v9)

fields.name: grp_ff12f49
fields.basis: ff12-money-ff49-v1, cellwise on row t: ff12 = grp_ff12[t], ff49 = grp_ff49[t]; 100 + ff49 when ff12 == 11 (Money) and ff49 in {45, 46, 47, 48} (145 Banks, 146 Insur, 147 RlEst, 148 Fin); otherwise ff12 (a Money SIC that Siccodes49 does not list -> 11; every non-Money cell -> ff12 bit for bit, 1-10 and 12; ff12 NaN -> NaN) (formula id ff12-money-ff49-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_v8.py, fields-v10)

fields.name: k8_count_63
fields.basis: distinct original 8-K accessions of the CIK that became usable within the last 63 sessions (usable from session e: counted at t for e <= t < e + 63; a filing is usable from the session after its event session, the first session whose 22:00 UTC mark follows its acceptance); NaN unless the CIK has a visible original 8-K with available_at within 365 days before the 22:00 UTC mark of t-1 (formula id sec-k8-count63-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_sec.py, fields-v8)

fields.name: inst_own_chg_q
fields.basis: inst_own_share(P) - inst_own_share(P-1) for the anchor quarter P and the preceding calendar quarter P-1, each at its own quarter-end session (share-basis invariant); NaN when either is NaN (formula id 13f-asof45-io-chg-q-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_holdings.py, fields-v9)

fields.name: nt_first_126
fields.basis: sec-nt-first365-126-v1 on the sec_filings stage: notices = events.parquet rows whose form, upper-cased and trimmed, is 'NT 10-K', 'NT 10-Q' or 'NT 20-F' with is_amendment false (a null is_amendment or a '/A' form is an amendment: dropped), one row per (cik, accession) with the later available_at if rows disagree; a notice is first when no other notice of the same CIK has available_at in [available_at - 365 days, available_at); a first NT 10-K or NT 10-Q is usable from session e = the session after the first session whose 22:00 UTC mark follows its available_at (SEC_CLOCK); value at t = 1 if a first NT 10-K or NT 10-Q of the line's CIK has e <= t < e + 126, else 0 (formula id sec-nt-first365-126-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_v9.py, fields-v13)

fields.name: div_month_pred
fields.basis: hs-divseason-q3-6-9-12-v1. Ledger: for each line and each observed extended session s with an earlier observation p (the line's previous one), y = 1 - F_p / F_s; s is an ex-date iff 0.0001 <= y <= 0.04, no kept_gap step lies in (p, s], and (p, s) is not a factor-break-v1 jump cell (|ln F_s/F_p| > 0.01 and |ln P_s/P_p| > |ln C_s/C_p| + 0.01, P = C F: a factor step with no matching raw price drop). Row t: M = the calendar month of session t; paid(m) = an ex-date in month m at an extended row <= t - 1; n_paid = the number of months m in M-12..M-1 with paid(m); a quarterly payer has 3 <= n_paid <= 6 and its first observation at or before the first session of month M-12; value = 1 if paid(M-k) for some k in (3, 6, 9, 12), else 0, for a quarterly payer; NaN otherwise (non-payers, annual and semiannual payers, monthly payers, short history). vendor observations of the role's lines on the extended axis (NYSE rule sessions before the role, the role's sessions inside it): research_fields_price SOURCE_RULE (unique positive key, finite positive close and cumulReturnFactor, finite volume >= 0; F = the chained factor with every factor-break-v1 repaired step divided out; a span across a kept_gap step is unusable) (formula id hs-divseason-q3-6-9-12-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_xdata.py, fields-v13)

fields.name: beta_dvol_21
fields.basis: ahxz-beta-dvol-spy21-v1. Market line: the unique vendor securityID whose ticker_tk is 'SPY' on every row read (another securityID with that ticker -> refused). Per extended session s: r_SPY(s) = P_s / P_(s-1) - 1 of the SPY line (observations at s and the previous extended session; excluded when |ln P ratio| > 1.5, > |ln C ratio| + 0.10, or a factor-break-v1 jump cell); dIV(s) = IV_s - IV_(s-1), IV = atmCenI_21d kept iff float32(0.02) <= v <= float32(5.0) (IV_DOMAIN). Line return r(s) = P_s / P_(s-1) - 1 with observations at s and s-1, no kept_gap step in (s-1, s] and the house guard (|ln P ratio| <= 1.5 and <= |ln C ratio| + 0.10). Row t: the days s in t-21..t-1 with r, r_SPY and dIV finite (K days); OLS r = a + b1 r_SPY + b2 dIV on them; value = b2 when K >= 17 and the two regressors are not collinear (det > 1e-10 s11 s22 of their centred cross-products), else NaN. Raw returns (no risk-free rate: a constant shift moves only the intercept). vendor observations of the role's lines on the extended axis (NYSE rule sessions before the role, the role's sessions inside it): research_fields_price SOURCE_RULE (unique positive key, finite positive close and cumulReturnFactor, finite volume >= 0; F = the chained factor with every factor-break-v1 repaired step divided out; a span across a kept_gap step is unusable) (formula id ahxz-beta-dvol-spy21-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_xdata.py, fields-v13)

fields.name: season_y2_5
fields.basis: hs-season-y2-5-v1. Row t, e = its extended row: for k in 2..5, b = e - 252 k, a = b + 21; r_k = P_a / P_b - 1 with observations at a and b, no kept_gap step in (b, a], |ln P_a/P_b| <= |ln C_a/C_b| + 0.10 (the coskew monthly guard) and a <= e - 1; value = the mean of the finite r_k when at least 3 of the 4 are finite, else NaN. vendor observations of the role's lines on the extended axis (NYSE rule sessions before the role, the role's sessions inside it): research_fields_price SOURCE_RULE (unique positive key, finite positive close and cumulReturnFactor, finite volume >= 0; F = the chained factor with every factor-break-v1 repaired step divided out; a span across a kept_gap step is unusable) (formula id hs-season-y2-5-v1; producer atx-engine/tools/research_fields_xdata.py, fields-v13)

families.description: Price-scaled fundamentals (book, earnings, cash flow, free cash flow, EBIT/EV, net payout, sales, R&D) and a composite of the book, earnings and cash-flow yields, ranked within FF12 industry; high value predicts higher returns.

Profitability and quality (gross, operating, cash-based operating, ROE, ROA, low accruals, F-score) and operating leverage (operating costs to assets), ranked within FF12 industry; high quality and high operating leverage predict higher returns.

Low asset growth, low net operating assets and low share issuance (XBRL and split-neutral vendor), and high expected investment growth (Hou-Mo-Xue-Zhang Eg: published slopes on log q, cash profitability and change in ROE), ranked within FF12 industry; low investment and issuance and high expected growth predict higher returns.

Earnings news: SUE, change in ROE, change in tax expense, the 3-day earnings announcement return, the streak of year-on-year quarterly earnings increases and an overdue earnings announcement (the expected 8-K 2.02 date passed); good news predicts continuation and a late announcement predicts lower returns.
12-1 momentum, 12-1 residual momentum, industry 12-1 momentum, within-industry momentum, nearness to the 52-week high and standardized 12-1 FF49-industry-residual momentum; winners continue.

Betting against correlation (low correlation with the market), low scaled MAX (largest daily return per unit of volatility), low MAX5 per unit of one-month volatility and QMJ safety (low beta, low leverage, low ROE volatility); low risk predicts higher risk-adjusted returns.

FINRA short interest ratio, days to cover, one-month change in short interest, the 126-session FINRA shorting flow (short sale volume / volume, within FF12) and SEC fails-to-deliver per share outstanding (21 settlement dates); heavy or rising shorting and delivery failures predict lower returns.
Industry-adjusted short-term reversal and same-calendar-month seasonality.
Implied-minus-realized volatility spread; high implied volatility relative to realized volatility predicts higher returns.
Informed-owner flows from SEC ownership filings: opportunistic insider net buying (Form 4) and 13F manager conviction; informed buying predicts higher returns.
Adverse SEC filing events: an 8-K Item 4.02 non-reliance disclosure within the last 63 sessions; a recent event predicts lower returns.
